report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show healthy spans across inventory, payment, order, and postgres (pool size 1, idle 1). Metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout ~98ms. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects normal latency. Operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off rather than assert a bounded cause.
